title: Summarizer output row (file summary)
description: One row of the summarizer's output table, answering one input row. Stored as CSV; list-valued cells hold JSON arrays. Every evidence quote must appear verbatim in that input row's excerpt or mentions.

summary.description: one or two plain sentences on what the unit is and contains

about.description: subject terms: organism, cell line, structure, assay, compound, disease, method

refers_to.description: other files, folders or file patterns the unit names

evidence.description: verbatim quotes from the excerpt or mentions that support the row
